trap.label: falso amigo
trap.why: Em português dizemos “é provável que funcione”, e o brasileiro cria “probable to”. Em inglês, “probable” não aceita infinitivo; use “be likely to + verbo”.

mcq.why: Consequently indica resultado; because indica causa.

mcq.q: A survey ___ that most staff like quiet days.
mcq.why: found é o passado de find. “Founded” significa fundar (falso amigo de “fundou”).

opts: In my view, it likely works to.
My view, it is likely work.
In my view, it is likely to work.
mcq.why: Use In my view + oração completa; likely to + base.

mcq.q: The news ___ a company that cut meetings.

fix.wrong: The report talk about a firm.
fix.right: The report talks about a firm.

fix.wrong: A survey found what workers are happier.
fix.right: A survey found that workers are happier.

rewrite.prompt: Una com um resultado: “Meetings were cut. Workers finished earlier.” (use Consequently)
rewrite.answer: Meetings were cut. Consequently, workers finished earlier.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com “is likely to”: “It will probably work.”
Reescreva começando com “A survey found that”: “Workers like quiet days.”
rewrite.answer: A survey found that workers like quiet days.
